observations: Native SwTable new-model insertion chooses the selected min/max row edge and copies the full source row count times with empty cells.
Native SwDoc constructs undo before table mutation, saves connected new boxes and appends history after successful insertion; defaults count1, behindtrue, insertDummytrue.
Native SwTableShell derives menu count from selected row coordinates; new SDI before/after slots are void actions without formal arguments.
Native SwFEShell insertion does not explicitly move the current cursor; native SwView pushes list, text, table contexts in that order.
Full native merged/nested/rowspan/redline/formula/layout/protection/repeated-headline and undo-section reconstruction remain unverified.
